title: drosera rupicola
intro: Drosera rupicola, commonly known as Rock Sundew, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Droseraceae family. It is native to Australia and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Rock Sundew include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
